Tripo shell + Z-Anatomy final internal-structure comparison

This presentation loads two independently attributed sources:

1. The retained Tripo female exterior shell and matching surface guides,
   documented in /vendor/tripo/ATTRIBUTION.txt.
2. Skeleton and organ meshes adapted from Z-Anatomy through the Vanatome
   pipeline.
   Project: https://github.com/Z-Anatomy/Models-of-human-anatomy
   License: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International

Final retained presentation state:

- The exterior shell, adaptive flow guide, and cleaned regional boundaries are
  the approved v15 Tripo assets.
- The skeleton is the v27 candidate with the retained shoulder, wrist, hand,
  foot, pelvis, thorax, and frontal humerus presentation corrections.
- The v28 organ layer contains 95 structures. Thoracic structures were enlarged
  18% laterally and 5% vertically; digestive structures except the oesophagus
  were enlarged 10% laterally and 3% vertically; kidneys and suprarenal glands
  were enlarged 8% laterally and 3% vertically. Depth was unchanged.
- The exterior shell and internal layers remain separate GLB assets at runtime.

These transformations are visual comparisons and are not medically validated,
diagnostic, or patient-specific registration. Preserve the upstream attribution
and applicable ShareAlike terms when redistributing the adapted Z-Anatomy
material.
